It was with sadness that we received the recent news of JACK FLOWER's death at his home in Ruislip. Jack was one of our prominent runners in the 1930's and figures in many of our winning and placed teams as we climbed the ladder of fame.

ALBERT MACHER, JACK MACHER and JACK FLOWER were collectively in our thoughts during that minute of remembrance; and sharing that moment too was JACK HARTLEY of Coventry Godiva, guest at our last dinner in his capacity as ECCU President, and whose loss is mourned by the Midland club and its neighbours.
